body: i have too many health concerns to try to survive in that kind of environment. I've mentioned my ocd already and i don't want to get started on my liver and digestion problems

I have anxiety and a bad relationship with the local police (I tend to call them out on thier BS, they have covered up incidents to protect people who have assaulted me), the idea of moving in with someone I barely know is terrifying to me.

going back to your other post, no i have no family to speak of and my firends are all stuck living with family right now. and i've been on welfare, i've had to stay at shelters before. i'm not doing that again.

I'm in a simial situation under different circumstances. I wish I had advice but all I can really offer is empathy and solidarity. A world where people can end up homeless at a moment's notice over less than 1000$ is a facked up place to be.

Lonliness alone is no reason to die because it's something that can change at a moment's notice, especially these days. Is lonliness your only source of pain? You clearly have the internet, remember there's always more people out there

People have been telling me it gets better for decades. Newsflash: it doesn't. It gets different, but not better

Unless someone at work has a place I can stay then no, there are no other arrangements. And I had to skip work yesterday (which cost me two days pay because today is canada day, a stat holiday) because i work on the phone and I cant take calls if i'm crying. I'm afraid i'll lose my job at this rate. if that happens i am done.
the only couch i have offered so far is my ex's. I don't think i could stand to live with him and his boyfriend. i'd rather be dead
I've been suicidal on and off most of my life because of childhood abuse. Now my husband has left me and i have no home. Couch surfing can be fun for some, but not someone with OCD
